extractions.value: Patient had a prior cerebral infarct in 1983 with residual left hemiparesis. Fibromuscular dysplasia of the right internal carotid artery was diagnosed. The opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome preceded the onset of PEM by several months. The patient died from pulmonary thromboembolism; autopsy was denied.
extractions.quote: Medical history was unremarkable except for a cerebral infarct in 1983 that left her with a minimal left hemiparesis... Percutaneous angiography was interpreted as fibromuscular dysplasia of the right internal carotid artery... Two months later, she presented with progressive paroxysms... she died from a pulmonary thromboembolism. Permission for autopsy was denied.
